scope: Complete installation and commissioning of one explicitly scoped access-control system with 8 controlled doors, 2 selected four-door controllers ACS-CTRL-4D, 16 selected readers READER-MF, 8 selected electromagnetic locks MAGLOCK-300 and 8 selected exit buttons EXIT-NO. CCTV, fire-alarm equipment, general-purpose LAN and building-wide UPS are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved security-systems design organization, access-control integrator, equipment manufacturer, commissioning authority and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved controlled-door schedule and access logic
approved controller, reader, lock, exit-device and door-contact schedule
approved local power-supply and standby-battery calculation
network, reader and lock cable schedule and containment routes
mounting boxes, terminations, labeling and fastening details
installation method with labor, lifting and test-equipment quantities
door-by-door functional, emergency release and fail-safe test program
controlled-door register and commissioning report schedule
conditional intercom and fire-release integration schedules
controller supplier package size and approved retained spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: door, device or cable quantities derived from floor area alone
static 432-m route or generic electrical productivity
automatic access logic, lock mode, power, battery or integration selection
universal spare quantity or supplier package
CCTV, fire alarm, general LAN or building UPS included
